entry.title: feat: add OpenClaw platform support (#527)

  consumers are detected (length 2-3 -> 2-4)

  agent-query-contract e2e specs

Aligns skill.json, marketplace.json, and plugin.json with the latest
v2.15.0 release; main was still at 2.13.0. CLI package version stays on
its own npm release track.

* fix: cover OpenClaw in offline validator and detection regression

- bump scripts/validate-agent-guide.py PLATFORM_COUNT 21 -> 23 (main

  gap to 23, so update the gate and keep it meaningful)

entry.title: fix(design): keep icon generator from corrupting SVGs or truncating o…
entry.content:
fix(design): keep icon generator from corrupting SVGs or truncating output (#526)

* fix(design): keep icon generator from corrupting SVGs or truncating output

apply_viewbox_size rewrote every width/height attribute in the document,
including stroke-width and child elements, and only handled double quotes.
Restrict it to the root <svg> tag and set width and height independently.

generate_icon capped output at 4096 tokens, which truncates detailed icons.
Raise it to 16384 and report finish_reason MAX_TOKENS separately from
empty or malformed output.

Fixes #525

* fix(design): apply the response guard and MAX_TOKENS diagnosis to icon batch

generate_batch still indexed candidates[0].content.parts unguarded and
printed a bare "No valid SVGs generated." Share the response-text
extraction and the no-SVG diagnosis with generate_icon, treat text=None
as an empty response, and warn when a batch is cut off at MAX_TOKENS
after returning fewer icons than requested.

Refs #525

* fix(design): match only real root attributes when sizing icon SVGs

_set_root_attr searched the root tag with a regex, so width= or height=
text inside another quoted attribute value (aria-label="height='2'") was
rewritten and the output stopped being valid XML. Walk the tag's
attributes instead, consuming each quoted value whole, and only replace
an attribute whose name is exactly width or height.

Refs #525

entry.title: fix(brand): detect token sources under unlisted CSS filenames (#523)
entry.content:
fix(brand): detect token sources under unlisted CSS filenames (#523)

The overwrite guard added in #501 scans a hardcoded list of CSS entry points
for `:root` custom properties and Tailwind v4 `@theme` blocks. The list only
held the plural `globals.css` spellings, so a project whose entry point is
`src/styles/global.css` — one letter apart — was never scanned. The guard
silently passed and `assets/design-tokens.{json,css}` was generated alongside
an existing palette, leaving two competing token systems and no warning.

Copying the same file to `src/index.css` made the guard fire correctly, which
confirms the detection logic was fine and only its candidate set was too narrow.

Widen the list with the singular spellings and `main.css` / `app.css`, then
shallow-scan a set of conventional style directories for any `*.css` so the
guard no longer depends on an exact filename. Detection itself is unchanged, so
the existing false-positive behaviour still holds: stylesheets with no custom
properties, commented-out `:root` blocks, and properties outside `:root` do not
block a sync.

entry.title: fix(threejs): replace deprecated Clock and PCFSoftShadowMap in r185 g…
entry.content:
fix(threejs): replace deprecated Clock and PCFSoftShadowMap in r185 guidance

The Three.js stack claims `threejs 0.185.1` but several rows still
recommend APIs that 0.185.1 deprecates and warns about at runtime:

- THREE.Clock (deprecated since r183) -> THREE.Timer with
  timer.update(timestamp) once per frame, getDelta()/getElapsed(),
  and timer.connect(document) to avoid a huge delta after a hidden tab.
  Rows 13, 31, 34, 45. Row 45 also stops calling getElapsedTime()
  per vertex (Clock.getElapsedTime() calls getDelta() internally).
- THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap (deprecated since r182, WebGLShadowMap warns
  and falls back to PCFShadowMap) -> PCFShadowMap, with shadow.radius /
  VSMShadowMap noted for softer edges. Rows 22, 23.
- GLTFLoader imported from three/examples/jsm -> three/addons, matching
  the rest of the file. Row 52.

Bump Verified At on touched rows, extend the freshness test's
forbidden-token list (three.clock, clock.getdelta,
clock.getelapsedtime, pcfsoftshadowmap, three/examples/jsm/) and add a
positive Timer lookup, refresh the relevance runtime fingerprint and
baseline, and re-sync mirrored assets.

entry.title: fix(design): make workflows self-contained, add bundled-skill contrac…
entry.content:
fix(design): make workflows self-contained, add bundled-skill contract (#498)

* fix(design): make workflows self-contained, add bundled-skill contract (#474 finding 2)

The design skill's banner and social-photos workflows named skills the plugin
does not ship (frontend-design, ai-artist, ai-multimodal, chrome-devtools,
project-management, assets-organizing) and claudekit command namespaces
(/ckm:brand, /ck:ui-ux-pro-max), so those steps fail or force the agent to
improvise under a plugin or CLI install. Rewrite them after the pattern of
#473: bundled skills stay referenced by name, optional tooling becomes an
optional runtime capability, unbundled steps are implemented inline or
dropped. The same references sat in references/social-photos-design.md, so
the fix covers the skill directory, not just SKILL.md; the CLI copy is synced.

check-asset-sync.yml gains a bundled-skill contract over both skill trees:
no /ck: or /ckm: namespace, every "`name` skill" reference must be a
directory under .claude/skills, and none of the claudekit-only names above
in any spelling.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(design): address review - list-aware skill grep, case-insensitive denylist, banner intro, report naming

- contract grep 2 walks comma/and/or lists so every member is checked, not
  only the last one, and accepts the sub-skill and bold forms; grep 3 matches
  case-insensitively; the step comment states what is not covered
- banner intro no longer claims "no sibling skills" while step 2 names the
  bundled ui-ux-pro-max skill
- social-photos report name stated inline instead of "naming pattern from
  session hooks" (a claudekit convention nothing in the bundle provides);
  "persistent" dropped from the task-list step; device-scale note scoped to
  tools that support it

Co-Authored-By: Claude Fable 5.1 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* fix(ci): match wrapped skill lists - read each file as one record in the bundled-skill contract

A Markdown list wrapped over two lines ("`playwright-mcp`,\n`brand`, and
`ui-ux-pro-max` skills") passed the line-oriented allowlist grep. Read the
file as one record (-z, separators as \s+) so wrapped lists are still lists;
a hit now names the file and the name instead of the line. grep's own exit
status is taken inside the substitution so an unreadable file still fails the
step under plain bash -e, pipefail or not.

entry.title: fix(brand): stop adjustBrightness collapsing dark color shades to bla…
entry.content:
fix(brand): stop adjustBrightness collapsing dark color shades to black (#497)

adjustBrightness() added/subtracted a flat 255*percent to every RGB
channel. For a dark base color (channels already close to 0), darkening
by -0.3/-0.45/-0.6 clamped every channel to 0, so shades 700, 800, and
900 all came back as the identical, useless #000000 instead of a graded
dark scale -- reproducible with any sufficiently dark brand primary
(e.g. #4A3228), not just an edge case.

Blend each channel proportionally toward white (percent > 0) or black
(percent < 0) instead, so the shift scales with how much headroom the
channel actually has.

Adds a regression test that syncs a dark brand color and asserts the
700/800/900 shades stay distinct and non-black.
